title: 1hohoky
Ghadir Khumm
hook: In the middle of the desert the caravan halted. A hand was raised into the air. On that day the wilayah of Imam Ali was proclaimed.
scenes.0.text: The Farewell Pilgrimage was over. The Prophet was returning from Mecca to Medina with thousands of people. **Imam Ali** had come from Yemen and joined him on the pilgrimage. At Khaybar the banner had been given to him, and at Tabuk the Harun comparison had been spoken. Now it was time to proclaim this standing before everyone.
scenes.0.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.0.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.1.text: The roads parted at the waters of Khumm. The Prophet halted the caravan. Those who had gone ahead were called back. Those who lagged behind were awaited. The sun was overhead. The gathering exceeded a hundred thousand. Some reports say 114 thousand people, others 124 thousand. The Prophet stopped this crowd in the desert because he was about to declare Imam Ali's leadership before everyone.
scenes.1.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.2.text: At Khumm the Prophet began the sermon. His voice rose in the heat. "Am I not closer to the believers than their own selves?" he asked. The crowd said, "Yes." The question was not asking only about love. The Prophet was asking who has the greater right over the believers. Once the crowd said yes, the Prophet was about to say to whom he was giving leadership. This is called wilayah, that is, leadership.
scenes.2.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.3.text: Then the Prophet took **Imam Ali**'s hand and raised it. "Whoever I am his mawla, **Imam Ali** is also his mawla. O God, befriend whoever befriends him, and be an enemy to whoever is an enemy to him." Mawla is the answer to the awla question just asked. Awla means a person having greater right than he has over himself. Mawla means leader. The hand the Prophet raised showed **Imam Ali** to everyone as the leader.
scenes.3.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.3.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.4.text: In the same sermon the Prophet left two weighty trusts: the Book of God and the ==Ahl al-Bayt==. "I remind you of God concerning my Ahl al-Bayt," he said. He repeated this three times. So that the 'itra, that is the Ahl al-Bayt, would not be separated from the Book, the Prophet bound the two to each other.
scenes.4.art.actors.1.label: 19izoul
The Prophet
scenes.4.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.5.text: After the sermon people congratulated **Imam Ali**. In the report Umar says: "Congratulations, O son of Abu Talib. You have become the mawla of every believing man and woman." **Imam Ali**, congratulated on that day, would soon be made to wait at the Saqifa. His leadership would be set aside there.
scenes.5.art.actors.2.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
scenes.6.text: This proclamation was not an empty word spoken in the desert and left there. At Tabuk the Prophet had said, "You are to me as Harun was to Musa." At Khaybar he had given the banner to the man who loves God and His Messenger. **Ghadir** is the proclamation of that standing before everyone's eyes. At the Saqifa they would try to undo this proclamation.
scenes.6.art.actors.0.label: lhg99z
Imam Ali
sunni.0.says: From Zayd b. Arqam: "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla."
sunni.1.says: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reminds Mu'awiya of three virtues of Imam Ali: the mawla saying, the Manzila, and the Khaybar banner.
sunni.2.says: The report that mentions Ghadir Khumm by name; the sermon and the taking of Imam Ali's hand; Umar's congratulation also appears in this report.
sunni.2.grade: Arna'ut: sahih li-ghayrihi; Ali b. Zayd in the chain is weak
sunni.3.says: The sermon at the water called Khumm: "I am leaving among you two weighty things: the Book of God and my Ahl al-Bayt."
sunni.4.says: The Book and the 'itra (Ahl al-Bayt) will not be separated until they reach the Prophet at the Hawd.
sunni.5.says: The Manzila hadith: "You are to me as Harun was to Musa."
sunni.6.says: The Manzila hadith; Mu'awiya says to Sa'd, "Why do you not curse Imam Ali?", and Sa'd lists three virtues of Imam Ali.
sunni.7.says: At Khaybar the banner is given to the one who loves God and His Messenger and is loved by them; Imam Ali is summoned and his eye is healed.
sunni.8.says: Many chains of the Ghadir hadith are included in the Mustadrak.
shia.0.says: Reports on the Ghadir event and on the wilayah of Imam Ali.
shia.1.says: The account of the event; Umar's congratulation is also related.
shia.2.says: A work compiling the Companion, Successor and scholar narrators and the literature of the Ghadir hadith.
shia.3.says: They relate that the verse "Convey what has been sent down to you from your Lord" was revealed at Ghadir concerning Imam Ali.
disputes.0.title: yb4gkl
What does "Mawla" mean?
disputes.0.sunni: At Ghadir Khumm the Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said, "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla." In the Sunni reading, mawla means friend, helper and supporter; the sermon exalts Imam Ali after the complaints about him and does not explicitly state the caliphate.
disputes.0.shia: At Ghadir Khumm the Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said, "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla." In the Shia reading, mawla is tied to the question "Am I not awla over the believers than their own selves?" and means leadership; the caravan's halt in the desert also shows the weight of the proclamation.
disputes.1.title: 1cuazta
When were Mâide 3 and 67 revealed?
disputes.1.sunni: The verse "Today I have perfected your religion for you" is in Mâide 3. In the Sunni reading, according to the report from Umar in Bukhari's Sahih, the verse was revealed at Arafat, on a Friday.
disputes.1.shia: The verse "Today I have perfected your religion for you" is in Mâide 3. In the Shia reading, the same verse was revealed at Ghadir, with the proclamation of Imam Ali's wilayah.
questions.0: The Prophet halted thousands of people in the hot desert and raised Imam Ali's hand. How does this care make you feel the weight of the proclamation of wilayah?
questions.1: The sermon opened with "Am I not closer to the believers than their own selves?" and then said mawla. When these two sayings are set side by side, what does Imam Ali's wilayah tell you?
questions.2: In the same speech the Book and the Ahl al-Bayt were entrusted together. Where does this trust place love for the Ahl al-Bayt in your life?
questions.3: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas listed Imam Ali's virtues. How do these words deepen your love for him?
summary: At Ghadir Khumm the Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said, "Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla"; this was the proclamation of his wilayah.
key: Imam Ali's right of wilayah: «Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla»
notes.0: Ghadir Khumm took place at the waters of Khumm on the return from the Farewell Pilgrimage.
notes.1: Ghadir Khumm is remembered as the second largest gathering assembled around the Prophet after the Farewell Pilgrimage.
notes.2: The number of participants is reported in the sources as over a hundred thousand (114 thousand and 124 thousand in some reports); the sources should be checked for the exact number.
notes.3: The Prophet raised Imam Ali's hand and said «Whoever I am his mawla, Imam Ali is also his mawla».
notes.4: In the Ja'fari school, mawla means leader, tied to the awla question in the sermon; Ghadir is the proclamation of Imam Ali's wilayah.
